Attach FANTOM CAT Tables to an Annotation

Source: R/transcript-features.R
add_fantom_cat_tables.Rd

FANTOM CAT distributes, next to the GTF, an ID mapping table (geneID, transcriptID, CAGEClusterID) and a gene information table (geneClass, geneCategory, TIEScore_tier, splicingType, directionality, transposable element associations, ...). This function joins them into the annotation directory: the CAGE cluster (the CAGE-defined promoter of each transcript) becomes cage_cluster_id, with its coordinates parsed into cage_cluster_seqid, cage_cluster_start, cage_cluster_end, and the gene information columns are added to the gene table in snake case. See download_fantom_cat_tables().

Usage

add_fantom_cat_tables(x, id_mapping, gene_info = NULL)

Arguments

x

An annotation directory path or an IsoformicExperiment.

id_mapping

Path (or data frame) of the ID mapping table.

gene_info

Optional path (or data frame) of the gene info table.

Value

The annotation directory path, invisibly.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
gtf <- download_reference(reference = "fantom", version = "lv3_robust")
tables <- download_fantom_cat_tables("lv3_robust")
annot <- prepare_isoformic_annotation(gtf)
add_fantom_cat_tables(annot, tables[["id_mapping"]], tables[["gene_info"]])
} # }
